description: This file defines a helper class for logging, providing static methods and constants to facilitate logging messages with different priority levels and handling log nodes. It essentially acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, enabling chaining and custom log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging, wrapping Android's native Log functions and allowing chaining of LogNodes.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will handle log output.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends log data to the current LogNode, with options for exception parameter.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion (assert) message with optional Throwable.
